core_prayers: Amidah (The 19 blessings of the Standing Prayer)

lifecycle.significance: Covenant of circumcision entering child into Abrahamic covenant

lifecycle.significance: Legal adulthood where the individual becomes obligated in all mitzvot
Wedding canopy, Ketubah (marriage contract protecting bride's rights), Seven Blessings (Sheva Berakhot)

stages: Yahrzeit & Kaddish (11 months recitation for parent)
